mapping_method: Recovered public-whitelist input, exact input texts and states retained; stable public IDs adapted with explicit scope notes.

mappings.input_statement: A worker at the institute died on 2 October.
mappings.input_statement_zh: 研究所一名员工于10月2日死亡。
mappings.scope_note: The stable death-report claim retains its meaning; reported_death_date and its source separately carry the 2 October attribution.

mappings.input_statement: Russian authorities described the illness as pneumonia of undetermined cause.
mappings.input_statement_zh: 俄方将病情描述为病因未明肺炎。
mappings.scope_note: OBSERVED in the input becomes SUPPORTED only for the proposition that authorities publicly used this description. The underlying diagnosis is not upgraded.

mappings.input_statement: Pneumonic plague was confirmed in the deceased worker.
mappings.scope_note: A verification request or suspected-event report does not confirm a diagnosis or an additional death.

mappings.input_statement: The death resulted from occupational laboratory exposure.
mappings.input_statement_zh: 死亡源于实验室职业暴露。
mappings.scope_note: An exposure chain and auditable incident review remain unavailable. This claim is broader than a link to a pathogen handled at work.

mappings.input_statement: WHO publicly stated that it requested additional information.
mappings.input_statement_zh: WHO公开表述已向俄方索取病因、促使采取措施的病原等进一步信息。
mappings.scope_note: Supports a verification procedure; it does not establish a pathogen diagnosis.

mappings.input_statement: WHO requested verification of media reports of a second employee with pneumonia.
mappings.input_statement_zh: WHO公开表述已要求核实第二名员工病因未明肺炎的媒体说法。
mappings.scope_note: A verification request does not confirm the reported second case.

mappings.input_statement: A second employee was confirmed to have plague.
mappings.input_statement_zh: 第二名员工已确诊鼠疫。
mappings.scope_note: A verification request or suspected-event report does not confirm a diagnosis or an additional death.

mappings.input_statement: A second employee died in connection with this event.
mappings.input_statement_zh: 本事件已证实第二名员工死亡。
mappings.scope_note: A verification request or suspected-event report does not confirm a diagnosis or an additional death.

mappings.input_statement: Reuters reported that Russian regulators said about 90% of quarantined people had been released.
mappings.input_statement_zh: Reuters报道俄监管机构称约90%被隔离者已解除隔离。
mappings.scope_note: Historical handoff attribution only, explicitly qualified by failed current access; no claim of fresh verification.

mappings.input_statement: A public post attributed to Tedros relayed that observation of all identified contacts had ended.
mappings.input_statement_zh: 署名Tedros的公开帖转述俄方称已结束全部已识别接触者医学观察。
mappings.scope_note: Underlying follow-up records are unavailable. Population and time definitions are not aligned with the 90% summary; neither summary excludes transmission.

mappings.input_statement: WHO had all necessary information and completed a fully informed risk assessment.
mappings.input_statement_zh: WHO已获得完整信息并完成本事件充分公共卫生风险评估。
mappings.scope_note: WHO said it lacked the full picture needed for a full assessment. This does not negate its earlier provisional assessment or establish high risk.
